chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu al-Subah al-Kinanī, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the siblings from the mother alongside the grandfather. He said, 'The siblings from the mother, alongside the grandfather, their share is one-third alongside the grandfather.'

key_terms.الْإِخْوَةُ مِنَ الْأُمِّ: Siblings from the mother (half-siblings sharing the same mother but different fathers)

ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of maternal siblings when the grandfather is also alive?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that maternal siblings receive one-third of the estate when inheriting alongside the paternal grandfather, a ruling that highlights the grandfather's role as a residual heir rather than an exclusive blocker. This specific configuration is significant in Shia jurisprudence for distinguishing between the 'grandfather' (who may be excluded by a father) and the 'brother' (who is excluded by a father), establishing a stable share for maternal kin even in the presence of senior male ascendants. The ruling underscores the principle of *fard* (fixed share) distribution before residual allocation, ensuring maternal siblings are not entirely displaced by the grandfather's presence.
